P-e341a.my_guess: SHAPING-TRANSFERS, WEAKLY (concurring with the lab lean; AMOUNT-NOT-TYPE the registered runner-up)
P-e341a.registered: GROUNDS: (1) THE DESIGN'S OWN ISOLATION — the fixed-context control runs the cons's own arithmetic at the cons's own step count and seed with the j=0 pool alone: at matched height-gain, matched name-token dose, matched optimizer and matched anchor structure, context variety is the ONLY remaining delta, and the chamber's three-class gradient names exactly this axis. (2) THE RE-KEYING ARGUMENT — the e147/e155 lineage law (the cliff): context/position variance forces a store off the coordinate-keyed wpe-row lookup into a context-invariant one; TAVIREN's install is coordinate-keyed BY CONSTRUCTION (e311's K10K-room write at fixed contexts), and the unshaped classes' first-step annihilation UNDER THE PINNED 0.7 BALL (CE_R healthy at the kill) is plausibly that coordinate-keyed fragility; the varied-context annealing is the one instrument in the record that re-keys a store. (3) THE CONTROLLER CONTRAST — fixed-context annealing at cons-class height ALREADY failed to buy s1 survival (e340's committed controller arm 0.873 -> 0.0037): height-without-variety is falsified as the margin. COUNTERVAILING (equal force): (a) the j!=0 windows shift post-name context AND the wpe columns the name occupies — the ingredient may reduce to 'the name at many positions'; (b) if survival is the read's absolute margin along the corpus direction rather than context-invariance, BOTH arms could survive at their raised heights (AMOUNT-NOT-TYPE); (c) the annealed heights are open bits (the g1d/g1e expression lottery) — an arm under the 0.15 floor runs ANYWAY as a REGISTERED DEVIATION, its verdict stamped (the g1d precedent).
P-e341a.predicted_shape: both annealings raise t0 to ~0.5-0.9; the TWIN replicates e338's committed class (s1 ~0.004, retention ~0.045); the FIXED arm dies at s1 (the fresh class) possibly with partial recovery (retention 0.05-0.25, the height effect); the VARIED arm takes a W1-class dip (s1 ~0.3-0.75 ABSOLUTE, never below 0.05) and holds, retention >= 0.5.
P-e341a.falsifier: the VARIED s1 < 0.05 (with FIXED dead -> LINEAGE-BOUND); the FIXED arm alive (both-alive -> AMOUNT-NOT-TYPE; fixed-alive-with-varied-dead -> the inversion MIXED).
